creator: Nguyễn Tiến Thịnh
observed: Hand holding blue Vietnamese twenty-thousand-dong banknotes. Portrait contain preserves visible denomination and notes; landscape crop truncates notes and makes amount ambiguous.

inspection.method: Opened original-aspect and center-crop contact-sheet tile for this retained image; reviewed visible subject and crop.

limits: Currency illustration only; not a particular character’s wages, bank balance or fictional payment. Multiple notes visible, so do not imply photograph itself equals one twenty-thousand payment.

location.evidence: Primary photo page location field says Vietnam; visible currency corroborates currency, not place.
